page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, providing 8 vCPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the CPU performance is generally modest. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, as well as Geekbench scores, place the instance in the bottom 25% tier. However, the system achieves average performance in Passmark CPU tests and large-block memory bandwidth read and write operations. Redis SET operations also perform in the middle 50% tier, while single-threaded compression tasks like gzip and bzip3 fall into the bottom 10% tier.

The ecs.se1.2xlarge offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for memory-bound workloads that do not require intense CPU processing. The lack of local storage means all storage must be network-attached, which, combined with the 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, may limit I/O-heavy operations. This instance is best suited for memory-intensive applications with moderate compute requirements, such as caching layers, small-to-medium database hosting, and basic memory-bound data processing.
